name: WA Lower fees, local skills (half-price TAFE courses)
provider: Jobs and Skills WA (Government of Western Australia)
summary: Around 160 WA TAFE qualifications at half price or less, with annual course fee caps of $400 (concession and youth) or $1,200.
key: An annual fee cap of $400 for jobseekers, youth up to 25 and concession holders, and $1,200 for all other students.
who: You must have left school and have your primary place of residence in Western Australia
The $400 cap applies to jobseekers, people aged 15 to 24 and concession holders
catches: Caps apply per qualification for each calendar year.
Resource fees may apply on top of the capped course fee.

source.label: Jobs and Skills WA: Fee Free and Low Fee training
